title: Computing extended persistent homology of radial distance filtrations of Euclidean shapes
summary: We study the extended persistent homology of the radial filtration of a shape $M\subseteq \mathbb{R}^n$. A radial filtration is formed by choosing a center point $c$ and taking points of $M$ within distance $r$ of $c$. We show that, under mild assumptions, we can recover the radial extended persistence of a manifold with boundary from the radial persistence of its boundary. We also establish algorithms to compute radial extended persistence when $M$ is a set of pixels in a 2D digital grid.
